title: Looking for an experienced Bubble developer to finish and grow a live AI SaaS app (web + native mobile)
text: Hi everyone, I’m the founder of Landman Tools , a subscription app that gives right-of-way and land professionals in the energy industry (pipelines, electric transmission, renewables, public works) AI-generated prompts and field notes built for their daily work. I have deep industry experience but I’m not a developer. I built the app myself in Bubble over the past several months, and I’m now looking for an experienced Bubble developer to help me finish it, make it more robust, and take it to native mobile. What’s already built and live Signup/login, password reset (SendGrid on a custom domain), onboarding screens, and in-app account deletion AI generation through the Anthropic (Claude) API using the API Connector, with a layered prompt setup across four categories. Generation runs in backend API workflows. An “Agent Note” feature that turns field notes into clean records, with voice-to-text through OpenAI Whisper Three plans (Free / Field / Pro) with monthly generation limits, Stripe Payment Links, a working checkout webhook that updates the user’s plan, and a Stripe Customer Portal for cancellations A saved-prompt library, copy-to-clipboard, and save confirmations Deployed to Live on a custom domain with real paying users What I need help finishing (short, well-defined tasks) Better failure handling: clear the previous result when Generate is clicked, and show a clear error if the API call fails Escape user input in one API call body so quotes don’t break the JSON (I’ve already fixed this on a second call) A full QA pass across all categories and all three plan tiers on Live A recurring-charge disclosure at checkout What I’d like help with next Building the native mobile app in Bubble for the Apple App Store and Google Play. My developer accounts are set up and the backend is already refactored for it. Hardening Stripe: webhook signature verification, plus handling subscription updates and cancellations so plan changes sync automatically Performance: generation has gotten slower, and I’d like a review of how the API calls and workflows are structured Future features: better visual for voice-to-text use, a state selector, document upload, and possibly a team/company plan A general review of the app’s structure, security (privacy rules), and anything I’ve missed as a non-expert What I’m looking for Strong experience with backend workflows, the API Connector, Stripe, and ideally Bubble native mobile Bubble Certified Developer preferred Clear communication and short notes on what you changed, since I want to keep learning and be able to maintain the app myself Fixed price per milestone. I’d like to start with a small paid test task. Willingness to sign a simple NDA If you’re interested, please DM me with: Examples of Bubble apps you’ve built, especially SaaS, AI/API, or native mobile Your hourly rate or how you price fixed-scope work Your availability per week and your time zone Thanks! 7 posts - 7 participants Read full topic
